rules.name: rule_range_bound120
rules.idea: RANGE: skip when the last 120 closed candles span < 9.2 ATR (base-train 20th pct; engine twin InpUhvSafeRangeAtr=9.2 + InpUhvSafeRangeBars=120). Best on secure (engine 98.66->99.00%, train 97.92->98.50, test 99.32->99.46) and significant on secure train (lift 2.10, p=0.029) and base train (1.40, p=0.041), BUT base test lift 0.81 (0.66 beyond the existing guards, WR 98.60->98.53), tight 99.44->99.28, secure-test lift 1.76 (p=0.24) is below the random control's 2.55, and its O/E trend is noise against both random-entry nulls (perm p 0.21 / 0.96). FAILS: does not travel to the base test half.
rules.code:
def rule_range_bound120(t, A):
    """RANGE: the last 120 closed candles span fewer than 9.2 ATRs (base-train 20th pct) - a sideways box where the break is a poke at
    its edge. Engine twin: InpUhvSafeRangeAtr=9.2 + InpUhvSafeRangeBars=120 (uhv_filters.secure)."""
    k = t["k"]
    a = float(A.atr[k])
    return a > 0 and float(A.h[k - 119:k + 1].max() - A.l[k - 119:k + 1].min()) < 9.2 * a

rules.name: rule_extended_run120
rules.idea: EXTENSION: skip when the level is > 19.2 pips beyond the 2-hour opposite extreme (base-train 80th pct). Its family (run120 / mv60 / pos120) had the only significant O/E dose-response against the +-90-min null (run120 p=0.003 after 141 features) - and it VANISHED against the path-free other-days null (best feature p=0.14): random entries placed inside the same run-up won because of it. Raw lifts: secure 0.90 / 1.07, base 1.25 / 0.89 (0.96 / 0.90 beyond guards). FAILS.
rules.code:
def rule_extended_run120(t, A):
    """EXTENSION: the level already sits more than 19.2 pips beyond the 2-hour opposite extreme (base-train 80th pct) - buying the top of
    a 2-hour climb / selling the bottom of a slide."""
    PIP = 1e-4
    k, s, lv = t["k"], t["side"], t["level"]
    run = (lv - float(A.l[k - 119:k + 1].min())) if s > 0 else (float(A.h[k - 119:k + 1].max()) - lv)
    return run / PIP > 19.2

rules.name: rule_with_move60
rules.idea: MOMENTUM EXTENSION: skip when the last 60 closes moved > 8.1 pips with the trade (base-train 80th pct). Nudges the win rate up in all four cells (secure +0.13, base +0.10) but no cell is significant (p 0.17-0.48), the secure gain is below the random-20% control (+0.18), and beyond the existing guards base train lift drops to 0.82 (WR 96.64->96.49). FAILS.
rules.code:
def rule_with_move60(t, A):
    """EXTENSION (momentum form): the last 60 closes moved more than 8.1 pips in the trade's direction (base-train 80th pct)."""
    PIP = 1e-4
    k = t["k"]
    return float(A.c[k] - A.c[k - 60]) * t["side"] / PIP > 8.1

rules.name: rule_congested_level
rules.idea: DOUBLE / TRIPLE TOP: skip when >= 6 confirmed 3-bar swing extremes (older than the UHV, last 240 bars) sit within 1 pip of the level (base-train 80th pct). The charts' commonest story (0309, 0414, 0526, 1019, 1023 ...), but the winning twins show the same picture (0309-075007-B, 1023-141514-B bought the very same tops and won). Lifts secure 1.23 / 1.28, base 0.84 / 1.13 (0.87 / 0.88 beyond guards). FAILS.
rules.code:
def rule_congested_level(t, A):
    """DOUBLE / TRIPLE TOP: 6 or more confirmed 3-bar swing highs (buy) / lows (sell) from before the UHV, in the last 240 candles, sit
    within 1 pip of the break level (6 = base-train 80th pct) - the price has been turned back there again and again."""
    PIP = 1e-4
    k, ku, s, lv = t["k"], t["ku"], t["side"], t["level"]
    h, l = A.h, A.l
    n = 0
    for j in range(max(3, k - 240), min(k - 3, ku - 1) + 1):          # pivot j is confirmed by bars j+1..j+3 <= k, and is older than the UHV
        if s > 0:
            if h[j] >= h[j - 3:j].max() and h[j] >= h[j + 1:j + 4].max() and abs(h[j] - lv) <= 1.0 * PIP:
                n += 1
        elif l[j] <= l[j - 3:j].min() and l[j] <= l[j + 1:j + 4].min() and abs(l[j] - lv) <= 1.0 * PIP:
            n += 1
    return n >= 6

rules.name: rule_news_clock
rules.idea: NEWS CLOCK (no calendar): skip breakout ticks at minute :56-:03 or :25-:30. Lifts all four cells (secure 98.66->99.05, base 97.74->97.96) BUT the windows were picked from the 30 losses' own timestamps (data-snooped); different sub-windows carry different cells (:25-:30 only in train - secure 4.3%, base 5.4%; :56-:03 only in base test 2.4% vs 1.2%, flat in base train); secure test gains +0.02 (lift 1.09); beyond the existing guards the base lifts are 1.13 / 1.16 (p=0.26 / 0.31). Its only significant cell (secure train, p=0.015) is the one it was read from. FAILS as a rule; a real economic calendar (MQL5 CalendarValueHistory) is the proper test of 0831-140012-S / 1002-121909-S / 0527-123600-B.
rules.code:
def rule_news_clock(t, A):
    """NEWS CLOCK (no calendar): the breakout tick lands in minute :56-:03 or :25-:30 of the hour (scheduled data, hourly flow)."""
    import datetime as dt
    m = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(t["t_dec"], dt.timezone.utc).minute
    return m >= 56 or m <= 3 or 25 <= m <= 30

rules.name: rule_chop120
rules.idea: CHOP: skip when the efficiency ratio of the last 120 closes < 0.031 (base-train 20th pct). Secure lifts 1.60 / 1.21 (n.s.), base 1.06 / 0.80 (1.03 / 0.74 beyond guards; base test WR 98.60->98.53). FAILS.
rules.code:
def rule_chop120(t, A):
    """CHOP: the efficiency ratio of the last 120 closes is below 0.031 (base-train 20th pct) - two hours that went nowhere."""
    import numpy as np
    k = t["k"]
    cc = A.c[k - 120:k + 1]
    path = float(np.abs(np.diff(cc)).sum())
    return path > 0 and abs(float(cc[-1] - cc[0])) / path < 0.031

rules.name: rule_wide_spread_now
rules.idea: SPREAD vs ITS OWN HOUR: skip when the breakout spread is > 0.05 pip above the 60-candle median per-minute spread (sim sp1; regime-free across the June spread cut 0.55 -> 0.14 pip). Mechanically sound (the bid must climb spread + 0.1 pip to win) and base lifts 1.81 (p=0.005) / 1.34 - but that lift is entirely the rollover hour and >= 1-pip spreads the secure setting already blocks (beyond them 1.22 / 0.74), and on secure it does nothing (0.92 / 1.14; secure train WR 97.92->97.90). FAILS.
rules.code:
def rule_wide_spread_now(t, A):
    """SPREAD vs ITS OWN HOUR: the breakout tick's spread is more than 0.05 pip above the median per-minute spread (sim 'sp1') of the last
    60 candles - regime-free (Mar-May ~0.55 pip, Jun-Nov ~0.14). Mechanical: the bid must climb spread + 0.1 pip to reach the target."""
    import numpy as np
    PIP = 1e-4
    if not hasattr(rule_wide_spread_now, "sp1"):
        import os
        import sys
        os.environ.setdefault("NUMBA_CPU_NAME", "generic")
        root = r"C:/Users/zeesh/turtle/monitor/TurtleTVUHV"
        if root not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, root)
        import sim
        rule_wide_spread_now.sp1 = np.asarray(sim.data("year1")["sp1"], dtype=float)
    k = t["k"]
    return t["trig_spread_pips"] > float(np.median(rule_wide_spread_now.sp1[k - 59:k + 1])) / PIP + 0.05

rules.name: control_random20
rules.idea: CONTROL, not a rule: a pseudo-random 20% skip (crc32 of the id). Secure 98.66->98.84 and secure-test lift 2.55 (p=0.074) by luck alone - the noise floor any rule must beat with 30 losses; base 97.74->97.57.
rules.code:
def control_random20(t, A):
    """CONTROL: skips a pseudo-random 20% of trades (crc32 of the id) - the noise floor any rule must beat."""
    import zlib
    return zlib.crc32(t["id"].encode()) % 5 == 0
